name: Ringzel
tagline: AI receptionist that answers the calls you can't take
description: Ringzel is an AI receptionist for small businesses that answers missed calls, books jobs and takes messages, with a 14-day free trial, then from £99 a month. Keep your number and divert the calls you miss. It answers in your business name, says it is automated and sends a call summary. Apps for iOS and Android. It is built for small service businesses such as trades, salons and clinics.
